summary: Frontend-only verification of Rate Wall overlay refactor. Rate Wall no longer inline on the home page; instead a full-screen overlay (tips-window) is opened via 3 triggers: desktop header green button (view-tips-btn), mobile full-width green button (view-tips-btn-mobile), and hero secondary button (hero-rate-btn). All 6 requested scenarios PASS.

test_results.home_page_no_tip_cards: PASS - 0 tip cards on home (desktop and mobile)
test_results.desktop_view_tips_btn_opens_overlay: PASS - tips-window opens; 2 tip cards visible (Portugal & Häcken parlay)
test_results.tips_window_close_btn: PASS - closes overlay and returns to home
test_results.sort_and_status_filters_in_overlay: PASS - sort-new, sort-hype, sort-top, status-pending/live/won/lost all present and clickable; sort-hype click keeps 2 tip cards visible

critical_code_review_comments: Header still has a dead nav link <a href='#ratewall'> (data-testid nav-ratewall). Since the Rate Wall no longer lives on the home page as a section, this anchor scrolls to nothing. Consider either converting nav-ratewall to also trigger onViewTips or removing it to avoid a broken/inert nav link.
